dialogues.speaker: Stream
dialogues.text: Um, Firecracker, I think you've had enough...

dialogues.speaker: Firecracker
dialogues.text: Look, I'm just really happy for you, okay? *hiccup* Happy for... all of us... the entire Forest!

dialogues.speaker: Stream
dialogues.text: Listen to you... You're going to ruin your voice if you keep going!
